fact: Prime Minister's Order No 161/03 of 12/09/2019 makes the Rwanda Revenue Authority responsible for assessing and collecting taxes and fees on behalf of decentralised entities, for a service cost of 5% of taxes and 10% of fees collected.
title: Prime Minister's Order Nº 161/03 of 12/09/2019 determining the institution in charge of assessment and collection of taxes and fees on behalf of decentralised entities
publisher: Official Gazette of the Republic of Rwanda no. 37 of 23/09/2019
